atlases.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Unity 2D survival RPG character animation atlas. Redesign this companion with a distinctly individual silhouette and face. Reference image supplies ONLY the polished hand-painted chibi sprite rendering style, crisp dark outline, three-head-tall proportions, and very slightly elevated orthographic world-character camera. Do not copy its generic brown fur outfit or face.
OUTPUT EXACTLY a square 3-column by 3-row sprite sheet, 9 equally sized cells, clean transparent gutters, NO labels or grid lines. Each cell shows the SAME complete character at consistent scale and head size, all feet and accessories fully inside its own cell with 8% clear margin. Columns left to right: directly FRONT facing screen down, directly BACK facing screen up, true RIGHT SIDE PROFILE facing screen right. Rows top to bottom: neutral idle feet together; walking step A left foot forward right foot back; walking step B right foot forward left foot back. Step A and B must have visibly opposite leg silhouettes, not identical poses. Keep same head, outfit, equipment, hair, body width and limb lengths across all nine cells. Gear stays attached to the SAME ANATOMICAL SIDE, never mirror front/back to fake a new step. Empty hands lightly counter-swing. World sprite 3-head proportions; view is very slightly from above, no isometric diagonal facing. No horizon, scene, floor, ground shadow, lettering, UI, extra people or watermark. Use real transparent alpha around the character, not painted black/white/checkerboard. All characters remain warmly dressed for snowy outdoors without using the same fur-trim outfit.
